The '''C-203 Heavy Repeating Shrieker''' was a type of [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]] produced during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
